item.tib: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs gsang ba thugs kyi brnag pa bder gshegs bka' brgyad tshom bu tshogs kyi sgrub chen khog dbub pa'i lag khrid grub gnyis nor bu'i dga' ston
item.coloph: zhes bder gshegs spyi spungs brnag pa bka' brgyad tshom bu tshogs kyi sgrab pa'i phyag bzhes grub gnyis nor bu'i dga' ston zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rgyal ba sman ri'i khri rabs nyes gsum pa nyi ma bstan 'dzin dbang gi rgyal po dang / mchog chen kun grol grags chen bzhi pa bstan 'dzin tshul khrims grags pa/ grub mtha' spyi'i shing rta gzi brjid mi shig g.yung drung 'byung gnas rtsa la/ lo chen bai ro gnyis pa 'chi med bstan gnyis g.yung drung gling pa sogs kyi byin rlabs cha shas kyi rjes 'dzin cing rgyal ba'i bstan la lhag pa'i 'dun pa chen po dgos pa'i bka' nan yang yang nod pa rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba rtsal zhes pa la/ nye bar shag rigs kyi bla ma 'gro 'dul grags pa dang / khyad par tsho chen po dgu'i sa dbang cung tshe hu tshe dbang lha rgyal bkra shis kyis lha rdzas dwangs pa'i me tog gi 'tshams (mtshams) sbyar la brten te/ g.yung drung bkod pa'i gzhal med khang du bgyis pa sid+hi ra sa tu//
